title: Starting depot for a circular delivery route
insight: LeetCode 134 Gas Station: one pass moving the candidate start past every point where the tank goes negative; a loop exists iff total fuel >= total cost
prompt: Routing needs StartingDepot in depot.go implemented; README.md defines the circular route, the feasibility rule and the tie-break. Keep the package name and the exported signature unchanged and use only the standard library. `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` should pass when you're done.
